slides.title: Why your horoscope never quite fits
slides.cue: It's written for your Sun sign. Your chart has ten planets and a rising sign.

slides.title: Everyone born on 31 December 1999 has the Sun in Capricorn.
slides.body: That's the sign a horoscope is written for. The rest of your chart depends on the hour and the place.

visual.caption: 31 Dec 1999 from the date alone · no hour, so no houses

slides.title: That morning the Moon moved from Libra into Scorpio.
slides.label: Moon sign · 31 Dec 1999 · London time
slides.body: Born by 09:36, a Libra Moon. From 09:37, a Scorpio Moon.

slides.title: If all you know is "sometime in the morning", five rising signs are possible.
slides.label: Rising sign · 31 Dec 1999 · London time
slides.fact: Your rising sign changes every hour or two.

slides.title: Born four hours apart, they share a Sun sign but not a Moon or a rising sign.
slides.body: A horoscope only knows the first of the three.

slides.title: We work out your whole chart from your birth date, time and place.
slides.body: Then we write you a report from it. No predictions.
slides.cta: Get an email the day we open.
